dialogues.speaker: Fontemer Aberrant: Armored Crab
dialogues.text: "When the apostle of the Golden City still walked among us, I once saw creatures like this in the southern territories."

dialogues.speaker: Fontemer Aberrant: Armored Crab
dialogues.text: "The Great Mother who granted us life — I would not dare speak her sacred name — what might she think, knowing one of her creations has been confined here...?"

dialogues.speaker: Fontemer Aberrant: Armored Crab
dialogues.text: "Though perhaps the thought is futile. In the end, what place in this world is not a cage?"
